method: Numbered Kyrgyz-to-English line review with adjacent printed-page context and lexical checks; proposal only
uncertainty: Row 45 has opaque жагданып жибек бөлүнбөй; proposed English is deliberately literal and requires specialist review against the printed scan.
Row 48's аркардын жибек белиндей metaphor is kept close to the Kyrgyz; exact physical referent of silk-like waist is uncertain.
Row 67's collocation укурук калбай, жан калбай is kept literal; scope of the lasso/pole image is uncertain.
Row 80 is the first line of a sentence continuing onto page 984; калмышында means in the end, but the sentence referent requires that continuation.

corrections.en: He despaired of his precious life.
corrections.reason: кайран жан refers to dear life, түңүлгөн to losing hope; not another disappointment.

corrections.en: The wretched man writhed in anguish,
corrections.reason: бейтаалай is hapless person and чымырканган describes straining or writhing, not an insect.

corrections.en: Time after time,
corrections.reason: ар качандан бир качан is temporal formula; smooth syntax with next line.

corrections.en: He had suffered in this way.
corrections.reason: жапаа салып has suffering or affliction, omitted by draft.

corrections.en: The silk settled close without parting,
corrections.reason: Retains жибек бөлүнбөй and attempts жагданып; opaque phrase, flagged uncertain.

corrections.old: You did bad things and quarreled.
corrections.en: You did wrong by stirring up strife,
corrections.reason: чыр салып is to cause strife; direct second-person rebuke.

corrections.old: You don't look like a shepherd.
corrections.en: You show no sign of sparing a life.
corrections.reason: жан койчу means let a life be, not a livestock shepherd; түрүң көрүнбөй concerns appearance of mercy.

corrections.en: Like the silken waist of an argali,
corrections.reason: аркар is wild mountain sheep, not a proper name; keeps metaphor close.

corrections.en: When I look at your fierce bearing,
corrections.reason: айбат is imposing or fearsome bearing.

corrections.old: Like a cold breeze from the pass.
corrections.en: It is like the cold wind of a mountain pass.
corrections.reason: Retains simile while connecting to previous line's bearing.

corrections.en: With a low, swelling hum,
corrections.reason: күү-күү is onomatopoeic sound and күүлөнүп describes building force here.

corrections.en: Muttering deep in his throat,
corrections.reason: күңгүрөнүп depicts low rumbling speech, not necessarily grumpiness.

corrections.en: Sarybay thundered:
corrections.reason: күркүрөдү is rumbling or thundering; prior lines describe his voice.

corrections.en: "Since I became Sarybay,
corrections.reason: болгону begins temporal sequence with конгону in next line.

corrections.old: When Sarybai got on the horse,
corrections.en: Since I mounted a horse as Sarybay,
corrections.reason: First-person speech continues; атка конгону means mounted a horse or set out as a rider.

corrections.en: Since I came of age and became a warrior,
corrections.reason: эрешен тартып эр болуп is coming to maturity and becoming a man/hero.

corrections.en: A match for the sons of warriors,
corrections.reason: эр уулуна means a brave man's son, not his son.

corrections.en: Since I put on a golden crown,
corrections.reason: Participates in temporal sequence leading to rule.

corrections.old: I rode on a golden throne,
corrections.en: Since I ascended a golden throne,
corrections.reason: такка мингеним is enthronement, not literal riding.

corrections.old: The people rule, the people wait,
corrections.en: I ruled the people and cared for the land,
corrections.reason: First-person subject continues; калк башкарып, журт күтүп means governing people and maintaining realm.

corrections.old: I used to be a sarybai.
corrections.en: I have lived as Sarybay.
corrections.reason: Sarybay is speaker's name, not common noun.

corrections.old: There is blood in the court,
corrections.en: I held court and became a khan,
corrections.reason: кан is khan in ордо тутуп, кан болуп, not blood.

corrections.en: A chief seated in authority,
corrections.reason: бий means ruler or judge, not dance; орунтуктуу denotes established position.

corrections.old: Gather the people and hold the people,
corrections.en: I gathered the people and held the realm,
corrections.reason: First-person narrative; калк and журт distinguish people and polity.

corrections.en: Riding the clouds and scattering ice,
corrections.reason: Participial boasts belong to Sarybay's past, not separate weather clauses.

corrections.en: In those days when I roared,
corrections.reason: күжүлдөгөн кезекте recalls roaring past vigor.

corrections.old: No loop left, no soul left,
corrections.en: Leaving neither a horse-catching pole nor a living soul,
corrections.reason: укурук is a horse-catching pole with a noose; keeps hyperbole literal and flagged uncertain.

corrections.en: I scattered their very core,
corrections.reason: уютку is core or starter; быт кылып means breaking apart and scattering, not sweetening.

corrections.old: There are no animals left untouched by me.
corrections.en: No herd escaped my raids,
corrections.reason: мал is livestock and тийбеген in boastful raid context means untouched or unraided.

corrections.en: My Zulpukor sword and my steel spear,
corrections.reason: Зулпукор names a legendary sharp sword, paired here with steel spear; not an oppressor.

corrections.en: When I brandished them,
corrections.reason: күүлөп with weapons means swinging or flourishing, not singing.

corrections.en: All the vast heavens
corrections.reason: асман-көк is expansive sky/heavens, not an incomplete nominal phrase.

corrections.en: I possessed in those days,
corrections.reason: ээлеп турган кезимде refers to the time when he possessed or occupied the sky; restores first-person boast.

corrections.en: I sliced and ate the choicest horse haunch,
corrections.reason: жая is prized horse rump/haunch cut, not an unspecified object.

corrections.old: I was wondering where the naked man is.
corrections.en: And asked, 'Where is the death-bringer?'
corrections.reason: жалаңкыч denotes reaper or terrifying foe, not a naked man.

corrections.en: I sliced and ate horse-rib fat,
corrections.reason: казы is prized horse rib or belly fat, not goose (каз).

corrections.old: I was wondering where Balaket is.
corrections.en: And asked, 'Where is calamity?'
corrections.reason: балакет means misfortune/calamity, not proper name; parallel to death-bringer boast.

corrections.en: Oh, wretched Kuyaly,
corrections.reason: оңбогон is reproach or curse, not compassionate poor.

corrections.en: I have suffered greatly because of you.
corrections.reason: сенден көп күйдүм is speaker's distress caused by Kuyaly, not comparison of burns.

corrections.en: In the end, to this warrior,
corrections.reason: эр is man/warrior; калмышында means in the end according to Yudakhin; fragment continues on page 984.
